notes.title: Massive Overhaul Update
notes.content:
[p]Buckle up! 🚗💨 This update is the biggest one yet – the game has been completely overhauled with a sleek new modern interface and upgraded graphics for a stunning experience. We’ve added new cars, thrilling races, and challenging missions to keep you on the edge of your seat.[/p][p]And for the first time ever, you can take full control with [b]steering wheel support (G29 & T300)[/b] for the most realistic driving experience yet. Plus, we’ve crushed bugs and polished performance to make everything smoother than ever.[/p][p]Get ready to race like never before! 🏁

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43765429/27693373e8c128712b8614fbf2205b95cd1602eb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43765429/cc72e28ace5e4848f3d0d67a581fd98c7440fcec.png"][/img][/p]
